Subject: Channel partnership intro + questions on commission and lead registration

Marissa — thanks again for the quick call this morning. As discussed, Beacon Analytics is looking to surface Redwood as our preferred inference partner for customers that need lower latency inference and a predictable cost profile. A few things we need to align on before we loop in procurement at our end:

- Commission structure: what % for referral vs. active resell (we typically expect tiered rev-share for first 12 months then lower thereafter)
- Lead registration: how long is a lead protected once we introduce it? Any double-touch rules?
- Co-marketing credits: possibility for joint webinars and shared pipeline credits
- Implementation handoff / SOW cadence — do you have a standard partner SOW?

I attached a short overview of Beacon and rough ARR targets so you can see where volume might land. Happy to run a pilot referral on one prospect (Acme Logistics) to validate GTM motion.

Attachments: Beacon_Initial_Overview.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Samir Patel

Samir — thanks for the summary and for sending the overview. We like the fit. High-level proposal from our side (quick items so we can iterate):

- Referral commission: 20% of Redwood net revenue for first 12 months post-sale, then 10% for months 13–24 on renewals (applies to deals introduced & accepted under lead registration window).
- Reseller (formal managed reseller) discount: 30% list off-hosted retail price with minor co-marketing credit (negotiable by volume).
- Lead registration: 90-day exclusive registration from the date Beacon first provides written lead details. If Beacon provides a qualified MQL and we outreach within 14 days and convert, Beacon gets commission. No double-dipping with other partners — registration is first-come.
- Co-marketing: $10k MDF credit for first year per signed reseller agreement; additional credits by milestone.
- Term: 12-month pilot term for the pilot cohort with auto-renew unless either party gives 30 days' notice.

I'm looping in Rishi to confirm commercial viability and Laura to align on partner ops. If this looks OK in principle, legal (Neha) will convert to a short partner term sheet and MSA. I've attached a draft term sheet (Redwood_Partner_Term_Sheet_v1.docx) and the baseline pricing table.

Attachments: Redwood_Partner_Term_Sheet_v1.docx (DOCX), Partner_Pricing_Table.xlsx (XLSX)

Next step: can you confirm Beacon's target ACV bands and whether Beacon expects to take support/managed services margin? If you can share a sample customer logo we can use for the pilot announcement, we can schedule a joint announcement after the first closed pilot.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Marissa / Laura — quick internal note from GTM/finance perspective:

- 20% first-year referral is acceptable for small-mid ACV (<= $100k). For deals > $250k ACV we should consider a stepped scale (e.g., 25% for first $250k, then 12% thereafter) only if Beacon commits to a joint-SMB pipeline target. I don't want to set an across-the-board 20% for large deals without volume guarantees.
- 90-day lead protection seems short for enterprise sales cycles. Recommend 180 days for named accounts that Beacon will actively engage and provide sales touch evidence. For inbound/marketing-sourced MQLs 90 days is fine.
- We need a clause for resale vs. referral differentiation (who owns billing, support SLA, and renewal ownership). If Beacon handles billing we need a rev-share payout cadence (quarterly within 45 days).

Neha — please prepare the partner MSA checklist (IP, data handling, audit rights, termination for convenience).

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel partnership — proposed term sheet and lead registration

Samir — we've reflected internal feedback and attached an updated partner term sheet and a short FAQ explaining registration rules and payout cadence. Key changes:

- Added stepped commission table for larger ACVs (see section 2.1)
- Lead protection: 180 days for named enterprise accounts with active engagement (documented in the registration portal); 90 days for inbound MQLs
- Payouts: quarterly, net 45 days after payment is received; rev-share reporting via partner dashboard (monthly CSV export)

I've also included a sample registration form flow we intend to use in the partner portal. If Beacon is comfortable we can open a sandbox partner account and run the Acme Logistics pilot.

Attachments: Redwood_Partner_Term_Sheet_v1.docx (REVISED), Partner_Pricing_Table.xlsx (REVISED)

Would you be able to review and, if agreed in principle, provide a preferred signature path? We can route an updated MSA for countersign with DocuSign.

Thanks — Marissa
